newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS rates LatAm telecoms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS rates LatAm telecoms.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analysts Mickey Schleien and Marina Grande said on Friday they had updated ratings and prices on nine Latin American telecommunications shares.
-- They raised Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras to strong buy from buy and set a 12-month price target of $135 for the company's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
-- They raised Brazil's Telerj to buy from hold and set a price target of $185.
-- Compania Anonima Nacional Telefonos de Venezuela, or CANTV, was raised to buy from hold. The price target is $37.
-- Schleien and Grande lowered Telefonica de Argentina to hold from buy and set a price target of $34-1/4.
-- Telecom Argentina was cut to hold from buy. The price target is $55.
-- Telefonica del Peru was maintained as buy and the price target was raised to $26-1/2 from $23-1/2.
-- Telefonos de Mexico kept its hold rating. Its price target is $45-1/2.
-- Brazil's Telesp kept its hold rating and its price target is $300.
-- Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile SA was maintained as hold and its target is $28.
